entries.a18c93f999502bef: Guided by its philosophy of “contributing to local communities through the advertising business,” its medium- to long-term goal is to develop free media that delivers local living information to households nationwide. In the current period, the company began full-scale operation of an in-house developed system with an AI advertising production function and is advancing hybrid advertising that combines the reach of print media with the convenience of digital. The company also states that, through its collaboration with CHUCO Work In Co., Ltd., it has built a proposal structure for solving job-posting and recruitment challenges.

entries.de41ee3ef8121ec1: In the advertising media industry, information transmission and advertising methods are diversifying, and digital information is increasingly concentrating on global IT platform providers. Within this environment, the company states that it aims to become an advertising platformer that leverages its locally rooted strengths and its free magazine distribution network. Revenue comes only from Japan, and there is no revenue from external customers outside Japan.
